statements.text: Reading write_fresh_dir: the existence check runs before os.mkdir, so two renders racing on one --out could make os.mkdir raise FileExistsError, which main() does not catch.

next_action.action: Decide whether a concurrent-render probe is worth adding to the source tests; no repair is proposed from this QA pass.

findings.title: Concurrent renders to one output directory may crash
findings.problem: By code reading only: a render that loses the race between the existence check and os.mkdir would end with an uncaught FileExistsError instead of exit 2.
findings.recommendation: Add a concurrency probe or a source test before treating this as a bug.

handoff.notes: No bug reproduced; f-race is an unverified lead for a source test, not a repair.
